files.s: This file contains lemmas about the cotangent function, including useful series expansions. In particular, we prove that `π * cot (π * z) = π * I - 2 * π * I * ∑' n : ℕ, Complex.exp (2 * π * I * z) ^ n` as well as the infinite sum representation of cotangent (also known as the Mittag-Leffler expansion): `π * cot (π * z) = 1 / z + ∑' n : ℕ+, (1 / (z - n) + 1 / (z + n))`.
